title: Striatal astrocyte μ-crystallin (Crym) loss contributes to early-stage Huntington’s disease pathophysiology
title_zh: 纹状体星形胶质细胞μ-晶体蛋白（Crym）缺失导致亨廷顿病早期病理生理学
abstract: A striatal astrocyte subpopulation expressing μ-crystallin (gene: Crym) regulates perseverative behaviors, but its role in disease is unclear. We found that astrocytic Crym and μ-crystallin protein expression levels are reduced in human Huntington's disease (HD) tissue, cerebrospinal fluid, and HD mouse models. Selective astrocytic μ-crystallin restoration in a HD mouse model improved astrocyte and neuronal morphology, electrophysiology, gene expression, and early-stage compulsive and repetitive behaviors. Late-stage motor deficits remained mostly unchanged. Approximately 32% of the μ-crystallin rescued astrocytic genes overlapped with those dysregulated in human HD, indicating conserved molecular corrections. These results identify μ-crystallin-expressing astrocytes as modulators of HD pathophysiology and suggest that restoring μ-crystallin or targeting Crym-positive astrocytes could be beneficial in early disease stages.
abstract_zh: 纹状体星形胶质细胞亚群表达μ-晶体蛋白（基因：Crym）调节固执行为，但其在疾病中的作用尚不清楚。我们发现人类亨廷顿病（HD）组织、脑脊液和HD小鼠模型中星形胶质细胞Crym及μ-晶体蛋白的表达水平降低。对HD小鼠模型中星形胶质细胞进行选择性μ-晶体蛋白恢复，改善了星形胶质细胞和神经元的形态、电生理、基因表达，以及早期强迫和重复行为。晚期运动缺陷基本未改变。约32%的被恢复的星形胶质细胞基因与人类HD中失调的基因重叠，表明存在保守的分子修正。这些结果表明表达Crym的星形胶质细胞是亨廷顿病病理生理学的调节者，并提示在早期疾病阶段恢复μ-晶体蛋白或靶向Crym阳性星形胶质细胞可能具有益处。
